Repository identity, base commit, paired case, evidence stages and release fingerprints agree across the supplied records; the differing source-manifest and evaluation-source digests have explicitly distinct domains, and PRD persistence normalization is documented. Historical project reuse preserves scoped attestations without supplying candidate outputs for this bundle.
